jerrythegerbil · Oct 24, 2026

This will go unclaimed for a bit. It may still get claimed within the day, but

People do have the exploit. The risked opportunity cost of this being a honeypot (and handing over a functional exploit) vs just… not participating and hacking higher value targets (offensive actors) or not circulating any additional details (defensive actors who have privileged intelligence about the vulns) I just…

The value proposition here is so hilariously low for what is required to demonstrate stealing the bitcoin at all.

That doesn’t mean that people won’t try, and perhaps even succeed! But to what end? Demonstrating terrible math skills and a fundamental misunderstanding of the economics at play?

I, and many of my friends and cooks could take this easily. The difference is we know not to.

Make it $15-25k and it’ll get yoinked instantly.
